CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role' = 'admin',
    false
  );
$function$
